messages:
samira.k: Hey team, customer 'AcmeCloud' says they suddenly get 403 when opening Audit Log -> Exports > Retention settings. They used to be able to view. Screenshot attached in thread (link).
jorge.m: Can you paste the exact error? 403 could be entitlement or token scopes.
samira.k: Console shows a modal: "You do not have permission to view audit exports. (error: audit.view_denied)". API calls to /v1/audit/exports return: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": "insufficient_scope",
  "detail": "missing scope: audit.read"
}
```
jorge.m: Ok that looks like token scope. Is this user signing in via SSO? Or using API key?
samira.k: It's SSO (Okta OIDC). User logs into the console; everything else works. Only audit exports/retention pages blocked.
tina-support: Quick checklist — 1) confirm user role in SCIM/IdP mapping 2) check OIDC token scopes and 'aud' 3) ensure org has retention entitlements (billing)
maya-secc: I ran token introspection for the user's session token (redacted) — token claims: 
```
{
  "sub": "00u123...",
  "scp": ["openid","profile","email","console.read"],
  "aud": "redwood-web",
  "roles": ["engineering"]
}
```
maya-secc: Not seeing audit.read in scp. Also aud is redwood-web; our backend expects audience 'redwood-api' for tokens issued with admin scopes. If the IdP is issuing tokens for the web client, it strips the audit scope.
jorge.m: That matches. We had a change in the OIDC middleware last week that tightened aud checking — we now reject tokens where aud != 'redwood-api' for endpoints requiring entitlements. Could be the user's Okta app started returning 'redwood-web' after a config drift.
samira.k: Customer reports that other users in same org can view audit exports. Only this user can't.
maya-secc: Likely their Okta client config hasn't been updated (still using the legacy client). SCIM shows they're in group 'Auditors' but the OIDC mapping uses app-level scopes so group membership alone doesn't grant audit.read unless token includes it.
tina-support: Repro steps I used: 
1) Log in via Okta -> obtain id_token/session cookie
2) Call curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <session_jwt>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/exports
3) Get 403 with missing scope.
jorge.m: Temporary workaround: admin can create an API key with 'audit:read' entitlement and share with the user for now. Longer term need to update their Okta OIDC app so 'aud' = redwood-api and include scope 'audit.read' in token request.
samira.k: Customer asked if retention entitlements are also required separately. They are on a paid retention plan but wondering if that could cause 403.
maya-secc: Retention billing flags are checked separately. If user lacks audit.read you get 403 even if billing is correct. If billing is missing you'd get 402-like billing error or a different error code (audit.retention_unentitled).
jorge.m: Action items: 
- @tina-support confirm on the org side whether any other users on Okta app got their client ID rotated (possible recent change) (by EOD).
- @maya-secc provide an internal diagnostic command to validate token audience and scopes (below).
- @samira.k share customer's Okta app/client id (safely, redact secrets).
maya-secc: Diagnostic curl example: 
```
# exchange session cookie for introspect
curl -X POST https://auth.redwood.ai/introspect -d 'token=<token>' | jq
# ensure response.scp contains "audit.read" and response.aud == "redwood-api"
```
eng-oncall-bot: Incident note created: INC-20240503-78 linked to this thread (priority: P2).
samira.k: Customer has provided client id: 0oa7abcDEf. They say their Okta admin changed some apps this morning.
tina-support: Okta admin confirmed they recently switched a SPA app to a different OIDC client. They will reconfigure the client to request scope 'audit.read' and set audience to 'redwood-api'. They will message back when done.
jorge.m: Once they reconfigure they may need to force a re-login for tokens to carry new scopes. Also, if they use persistent sessions, they should revoke existing sessions so tokens are reissued.
samira.k: I'll send the workaround (admin API key) and the re-login guidance. Marking this for follow up when Okta confirms. Thanks all :thumbsup:
maya-secc: If they hit any token introspect mismatch after change, ping me and I'll check logs for token_aud_mismatch entries.
samira.k: Closing for now pending Okta confirmation — will reopen thread if 403 persists.
